CheckTitle: Ensure there are no S3 buckets open to Everyone or Any AWS user
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks whether S3 buckets are publicly accessible through ACL grants or bucket policies, taking account and bucket Block Public Access into account.
Risk: Public buckets expose data to the entire internet and are a leading cause of large-scale data breaches.

Recommendation.Text: Enable S3 Block Public Access at the account and bucket level and remove public ACL grants and public policy statements.
